channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Defense helps No. 8 Maryknoll top ‘Iolani in softball
item.description: Chacha Napoleon was clutch, Molly Davi was near perfect, but the biggest difference was defense as No. 8 Maryknoll broke open a close game in the fifth inning for a 13-0, six-inning TKO rout of No. 9 ‘Iolani in an ILH softball game on Friday afternoon.

item.title: 41 killed as Israel bombardment pounds Beirut suburbs
item.description: BEIRUT >> Israel warned Lebanon of a “very heavy price” if it did not rein in Iran-backed Hezbollah today, as it pounded the group’s strongholds around the country with air strikes and mounted a deadly airborne raid in the east.

item.title: Trump rejects negotiating with Iran as conflict continues
item.description: President Donald Trump said today he is not interested in negotiating with Iran and raised the possibility that the Iran war would only end once that country no longer has a functioning military or any remaining leadership in power.

item.title: Motorcyclist, 39, dies after crashing on Kalanianaole Highway
item.description: A 39-year-old motorcyclist died after rear-ending another motorcycle and crashing near the Halona Blowhole lookout in East Oahu late Friday night, police said.

item.title: Health officials confirm measles case in visitor to Hawaii
item.description: Hawaii health officials say they have confirmed a case of measles in a vaccinated adult visitor to Oahu.

item.title: Tornadoes kill 4, injure over a dozen in rural Michigan
item.description: Tornadoes and strong storms killed at least four people and injured more than a dozen in southern Michigan on Friday, destroying multiple homes and leaving hundreds of residents without power, local authorities said.

item.title: Rainbow Wahine shut down Long Beach State to earn 3rd straight 20-win season
item.description: Hawaii freshman guard Keiara Curtis scored 14 of her game-high 16 points in the second half and the Rainbow Wahine cruised to a 74-39 win over Long Beach State to end their regular season today at LBS Financial Credit Union Pyramid in Long Beach, Calif.

item.title: Furloughed inmate charged with stabbing 2 Oahu women, killing 1
item.description: The 55-year-old felon who allegedly stabbed his 53-year-old girlfriend to death on Thursday before critically injuring his estranged wife was charged today.

item.title: Trump witnesses return of bodies of U.S. service members
item.description: President Donald Trump watched as the remains of the first American service members killed in the U.S. war with Iran arrived in the United States this afternoon at Dover Air Force Base in Delaware.

item.title: Charles Oliveira dominates Max Holloway to win BMF title
item.description: Charles Oliveira completely overwhelmed Max Holloway in a one-sided unanimous decision to win the UFC’s BMF title in the main event of UFC 326 tonight at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas.
